watcher_nonstrict_cron.description: Cron schedule expression for non-strict ganeti-watcher (restarts failed instances); typically a range-based pattern for 5-minute intervals excluding some minutes.

watcher_strict_cron.description: Cron schedule expression for strict ganeti-watcher; usually once every 30 minutes.

cleaner_master_time.description: Cron time expression (minute hour) for master job archive cleaning; default is 01:45.

cleaner_node_time.description: Cron time expression (minute hour) for node job archive cleaning; default is 02:45.
